info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Loyalty Loyalty Points-v4-spec
info.description: The Loyalty Points Retrieval API allows businesses to access and retrieve the accumulated loyalty points of their customers. This endpoint serves as a vital resource for businesses aiming to enhance customer engagement and retention by providing detailed information about loyalty point balances. Typical consumers of this API include loyalty program managers and customer service representatives who need to provide quick insights into customer rewards. By integrating this API, businesses can streamline their loyalty program management and offer tailored experiences to their customers.

get.description: This endpoint allows clients to fetch detailed information about loyalty points associated with a customer. It provides an overview of the current points balance, eligibility for rewards, and potential expiration of points.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the loyalty points associated with a specific user account. The request must include valid user identification to ensure that the right information is returned.
